name: Owatanka
summary: Across the southern Barrens, Owatanka roams as a swift thunder lizard known to the tauren as Bluebolt. Slaying the beast yields a crackling tailspike, carried to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in honor of the elders’ tradition of learning from Kalimdor’s primordial beasts.

sections.title: The Beast Called Bluebolt
sections.body: Owatanka prowls the southern Barrens, where tauren hunters speak of him with reverence. Unlike his massive, plodding kin, he moves with blinding speed. The tauren call him Bluebolt, for the storm changed him.

sections.title: Fed by the Sky's Rage
sections.body: Tauren lore says lightning struck Owatanka long ago. The thunder lizard survived, and the strike filled him with unending energy and fury. Even after his death, his tailspike crackles with stray sparks when handled, a remnant of the storm’s power.

sections.title: Trophy of Taurajo
sections.body: Taking Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo marks a hunter’s prowess and spirit. Jorn recognizes the encounter in the eyes of any hunter who has outmatched the beast’s speed. Presenting the trophy honors Bluebolt’s enduring swiftness.

aliases: what kind of beast is owatanka
faq.answer: Owatanka roams the Barrens as a swift thunder lizard known to the tauren as Bluebolt. He crackles with lightning energy.

faq.q: Why does Owatanka spark with lightning?
faq.answer: Tauren legend says lightning struck Owatanka long ago. The strike left him filled with endless energy and fury.

aliases: where do i turn in owatanka
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer is a tauren elder and spiritual guide at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He recognizes the power of the region’s great beasts and accepts trophies such as Owatanka's tailspike.
Owatanka wanders the arid flatlands of the southern Barrens, through scrub and dirt pathways south of Camp Taurajo.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver Owatanka's Tailspike?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer commends you for outmatching the swift thunder lizard. He says keeping pace with Owatanka leaves a lasting spark of energy and power within you.

faq.q: Is Owatanka dangerous compared to normal thunder lizards?
faq.answer: Yes. Owatanka is swift and carries innate electrical power from the lightning strike of legend, as well as the toughness of a thunder lizard.

angles.text: As a tauren, hunting Bluebolt honors your people’s tradition of respecting wild spirits and claiming the vitality of the Barrens’ enduring beasts.
As a hunter, besting Owatanka tests your stalking and speed against one of nature’s swiftest giants.
As a shaman, Owatanka's tailspike shows how the sky’s elemental forces can reshape living creatures on Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, culling this unpredictable, lightning-charged predator protects the vulnerable supply trails near Camp Taurajo.
